args.lesson: What worked: I copied the package byte-for-byte under package/ and put the handoff at the site root, so the README's relative link still resolves. Hashes then proved integrity against the producer's manifest, with no content rewrite. I ran the stub tests from the site copy with an external output path so the published files stayed unmodified, and ran the documented default command (exit 2 DEPENDENCY_ABSENT). Dry_run digest 36292634... accepted nested dirs and .cjs/.md files. What failed: a currency regex without word boundaries matched 'EUR' inside French 'convertisseur' (26/27). Next time, use \b boundaries for short tokens in bilingual pages and print the matched hits on failure. My quote check also tested only a prefix; check full-phrase verbatimness against the rendered source text, which includes markup like <em>.
